<?php
class Base87A {
    public function stream($value) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base87A', '|', static::class === 'Child87A', '|', $this === $weak->get(), '|';
        try { Fiber::suspend('raw87'); yield $value; return 88; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weak->get() !== null, '|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child87A extends Base87A {}
function Run87A() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->current();
    echo 'VALUE|', $value === 87, '|';
    $g->next();
    echo 'RETURNED|';
}
$maker = new Child87A();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$route = [$maker, 'stream'];
$g = $route(87);
unset($route, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() !== null, '|';
$fiber = new Fiber('Run87A');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'raw87', '|', $weak->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'RESUME|';
$fiber->resume();
echo 'DONE|', $g->getReturn() === 88, '|', $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $weak);
echo 'E';

<?php
class Token87R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input87R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
class Base87R {
    public function factory($tag, &$token) {
        global $weakOld;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Base87R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf87R', '|',
             $this === $weakOld->get(), '|', $tag === 87, '|';
        return self::stream($token);
    }
    protected function &stream(&$token) {
        global $weakOld, $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base87R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf87R', '|',
             $this === $weakOld->get(), '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('raw87');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token87R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input87R, '|',
                 $weakOld->get() instanceof Leaf87R, '|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf87R extends Base87R {}
class Other87R {
    public static function bad($tag, &$token) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OTHER|'; }
}
function Retarget87R() {
    global $maker, $selection, $weakOther, $weakOld;
    $maker = new Other87R();
    $weakOther = WeakReference::create($maker);
    $selection[0] = 'Other87R';
    $selection[1] = 'bad';
    echo 'RETARGET|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Leaf87R, '|';
    return 87;
}
function Run87R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input87R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$maker = new Leaf87R();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($maker);
$selection = [$maker, 'factory'];
$token = new Token87R();
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = $selection(Retarget87R(), $token);
unset($selection, $maker, $token);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Leaf87R, '|', $weakOther->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token87R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run87R');
$stop = new Exception('stop87');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'raw87', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $weakInput->get() instanceof Input87R, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Leaf87R, '|',
     $weakOther->get() === null, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token87R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token87R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|',
     $weakOther->get() === null, '|E';
